ev.peril_fire.title: Fire
ev.peril_fire.text: The alarm bell rang in the night. Your {what} is burning. By morning only sooty walls and a heap of embers are left. The neighbours shake their heads: rebuilding will be costly.
ev.peril_fire.rebuild.ok: You hired carpenters and masons. The year went into building and brought no income, but by autumn it stands sturdier than before.
ev.peril_fire.sell_ruins.ok: A neighbour bought the plot to build on. Not much money, but better than nothing.
ev.peril_fire.abandon.ok: You gave up on the ruins. There's neither strength nor money for them.
ev.peril_flood.title: Disaster on the farm
ev.peril_flood.text: The river burst its banks, and murrain followed. Your {what} stands empty: fields flooded, livestock sick. The year is lost, and repairs will cost plenty.
ev.peril_flood.wait.ok: A year passed without income. The workers mended what was washed away and waited for the land to dry.
ev.peril_flood.sell_half.ok: A buyer turned up quickly - and named his own price. At least there's one worry less.
ev.peril_steward.title: The steward is stealing
ev.peril_steward.text: The family owns more than you can keep an eye on. The accounts don't add up: the steward running your {what} is clearly taking more than his due.
ev.peril_steward.dismiss.ok: You threw the thief out. While a new man was found, the business stood idle for a year.
ev.peril_steward.sue.success: The court made the thief return what he stole - and a little more.
ev.peril_steward.sue.failure: The witnesses kept quiet, the papers vanished. The court costs were wasted, and the business stood idle for a year.
ev.peril_steward.ignore.ok: You decided that everyone steals. The business runs, but the income is noticeably smaller - and it will stay that way.
ev.peril_disgrace.title: Disgrace
ev.peril_disgrace.text: Faces changed at court, and your family is now spoken of unkindly. Men came with a paper: your {what} is to pass to the treasury. It can be settled - for money.
ev.peril_disgrace.pay.ok: The right man took the gift, and the paper went missing. The estate stays in the family, but people whisper about you.
ev.peril_disgrace.yield.ok: You gave up the property. Arguing with power would cost more.
ev.peril_lawsuit.title: A neighbour's lawsuit
ev.peril_lawsuit.text: A neighbour claims your {what} stands on his land and has gone to court. He has witnesses and a clever scribe.
ev.peril_lawsuit.court.success: The old boundary records turned up. The judge left everything to you.
ev.peril_lawsuit.court.failure: The judge took the neighbour's side. The property went to him, and the court costs were wasted.
ev.peril_lawsuit.yield: Give it up without a fight
ev.peril_lawsuit.yield.ok: You handed the property to the neighbour. It stings, but it's calmer without a court.
